question: Which of the following word is the ANTONYM of the word ‘native’ used in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Exotic**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The question is asking for the antonym of the word 'native'.
 
• **'Native' means belonging to a particular place by birth or origin**.(देशी)
 
 
• Example: This plant is native to the Himalayas.
 
 
 
• While 'exotic' means originati
